portal_hypertension.title: Preventing First and Further Decompensation in Advanced Chronic Liver Disease.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Süffert LC, de Faria Moraes B, Cançado GGL
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：从代偿期 (cACLD) 到失代偿期 (dACLD) 的转变是由临床上显着的门静脉高压 (CSPH) 和持续暴露于病因因素驱动的，并且通常是由感染、感染等全身性触发因素促成的。 临床提示：晚期慢性肝病（ACLD）仍然是全球发病率和死亡率的主要原因。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Advanced chronic liver disease (ACLD) remains a major cause of global morbidity and mortality. Preventing hepatic decompensation-both the first event and subsequent recurrences-has become a central therapeutic goal to prolong survival. The transition from the compensated phase (cACLD) to the decompensated phase (dACLD) is driven by clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) and continuous exposure to etiologic factors, and is often precipitated by systemic triggers such as infections, portal vein thrombosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma. portal_hypertension.title: Letter to editor: Non-selective beta-blockers are well tolerated in pregnancy with portal hypertension.
portal_hypertension.journal: Indian journal of gastroenterology : official journal of the Indian Society of Gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：PubMed 没有可用的摘要。 临床提示：致编辑的信：非选择性β受体阻滞剂在妊娠合并门静脉高压症中具有良好的耐受性。

portal_hypertension.title: Abdominal vascular imaging with ferumoxytol - how we do it.
portal_hypertension.authors: Rees MA, Salman R, Krishnamurthy R
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：使用费鲁莫托进行 MR 血管造影扩大了儿科腹部血管成像的工具集。 临床提示：作为一种铁基血池造影剂，ferumoxytol 可以对腹部血管进行高分辨率成像，该成像不依赖于造影相位的精确时间，并且可用于有禁忌症的患者。
portal_hypertension.abstract: MR angiography with ferumoxytol expands the toolset for imaging the pediatric abdominal vasculature. As an iron-based blood pool contrast agent, ferumoxytol allows for high-resolution imaging of the abdominal vessels that is not dependent on precise timing of contrast phases and can be used in patients with a contraindication to gadolinium-based contrast agents. At our institution, it has proven useful for abdominal indications including vascular mapping in the settings of portal hypertension, portosystemic shunts, and abdominal transplant evaluation, as well as for investigation of vascular malformations and vasculitis.
